description: Communicate with clients, schedule appointments, and stay on top of your calendar, all by chatting with your AI assistant. Catch up on text, email, and voice conversations, see who’s waiting on a reply, and send responses or start new ones from approved templates. Look up and book appointments, check your availability across connected calendars, and keep contacts up to date. Mark participants confirmed, cancelled, or no-show to keep attendance accurate, while your existing reminders run automatically. It’s secure by design: you decide what the assistant can do, and it always confirms before sending or booking.
